title: Enterprise model-variant risk & retention playbook
creator: Nadia Chen
description:
Objective: Produce a repeatable playbook that quantifies risk when customers migrate between model variants (open weights, quantized builds, and hosted Redwood variants) and prescribes retention/mitigation strategies for enterprise customers.

Scope: 1) Competitive surface mapping (which vendors provide drop-in substitutes at API and prompt-level compatibility), 2) Telemetry-based churn signals (response regressions, latency spikes, cost delta), 3) Qualitative enterprise readiness checklist (compliance, SLAs, explainability), 4) Tactical retention playbook (fallback routing, model pinning policies, migration runbooks, customer comms templates).

Deliverables: 
- Competitive substitution matrix (rows: enterprise use-cases; columns: model families + variant types + compatibility score) as a Google Sheet.
- Risk scoring algorithm (simple rubric) and example scores for top 12 customer archetypes.
- Migration playbook: detection triggers, automated fallback config examples, customer escalation path, and a templated SOW for Dedicated/Private migration assistance.
- 1-page executive brief for GTM and CS including potential revenue at risk and recommended product levers.

Methodology: 
- Data pulls: token-level cost by model variant, latency p95/p50 by route, quality delta from stored eval prompt sets. (Owner: ENG analytics)
- Customer research: 8 enterprise interviews + 2 post-mortem case studies from churned accounts. (Owner: PM team)
- Competitive research: API diff tests (prompt-preservation, structured output parity) against 6 external model providers. (Owner: Research contractor + DES review)
- Validation: Run a controlled canary where routing prefers cheaper variant for non-critical routes; measure retention and incident deltas over 4 weeks.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Completed substitution matrix populated with >= 80% coverage of top 20 enterprise customers' primary workloads.
- Risk rubric validated against three historical migration events and scored within +/-1 band of observed business impact.
- Playbook includes at least two automated mitigation recipes (one runtime-level fallback, one billing/quote-based incentive) with sample config snippets and an associated Console dashboard wireframe.

Stakeholders: GTM (SaaS sales lead), CS (Enterprise success manager), Engineering (runtime & infra), Design (Console UX), Legal (for SOW templates).

Notes & links: 
- Confluence: /workspace/model-watchtower/variant-risk (drafts and raw research notes)
- Drive: gs://redwood-research/model-variant/substitution-matrix.xlsx (working file)
- GitHub: PR #1428 contains initial telemetry queries and example dashboard panels

Risks and trade-offs: 
- Over-emphasis on latency/cost metrics may underweight semantic compatibility; mitigation: include human-labeled evaluation on canonical prompt sets.
- Public competitor benchmarking may trigger policy/relationship concerns; mitigation: abstract provider names in external-facing docs and consult legal.
